theSPFindingConfirmedLive.isThisWrong: Arguably yes, and it is named as an open finding, not silently accepted: the land under these 3 parcels IS zoned (S-P, a real Elgin district), just geometrically covered by a polygon this repo never staged. The dispatch's two conditions cannot express that distinction because the information that would (the S-P registry) lives in hauska-engine, explicitly out of this repo's write scope. Inventing a third, S-P-specific condition or an exception list was explicitly prohibited by the dispatch on the grounds that an exception mechanism is reusable on parcels nobody measured -- so this is reported plainly rather than engineered around.
